board: GY-21 Si7021 temperature & humidity module (4-pin VIN, GND, SCL, SDA)
reason: Check passed on ESP32 and Pico. The no-hold commands 0xF5/0xF3 return 12-bit RH and 14-bit T with the datasheet's fixed low bits (10 for RH, 00 for T) and a CRC-8 (poly 0x31, init 0x00). 0xE0 returns the temperature from the last RH measurement with no CRC. The driver decodes the 16-bit codes with the datasheet formulas and clamps RH to 0-100 %.
